countChancersInQueue.name: Count the chancers
countChancersInQueue.description: Write a function that takes the queue and the guest list, and returns how many of the people queueing are not on the guest list.

solveTightly.name: Solve it tightly
solveTightly.description: Bonus: this can be written far more compactly than you might expect. Can you get the whole solution down to just a handful of lines?

emptyQueue.name: Nobody has turned up yet
emptyQueue.description: An empty queue, so nobody is waiting to get in.

everyoneChancingIt.name: The whole queue is chancing it
everyoneChancingIt.description: A queue where none of the people waiting are on the guest list.

everyoneInvited.name: Everyone is invited
everyoneInvited.description: A queue where every person waiting is on the guest list.

mixedQueue.name: A mixed queue
mixedQueue.description: A queue where some of the people waiting are invited and some aren't. One of the chancers has a name that looks a lot like a name on the list.

guestsWhoHaventArrived.name: Guests still stuck in traffic
guestsWhoHaventArrived.description: A guest list with lots of names on it, but most of those people haven't reached the queue yet.

longQueueShortList.name: A long queue and a short list
longQueueShortList.description: A big queue outside, but only a couple of names on the guest list.

guestListBonusLineCount.name: Neat and tidy: a mixed queue
guestListBonusLineCount.description: The same mixed queue as before, but this time your solution has to fit into a much smaller number of lines.

checks.tooManyLines: Keep going! See if you can solve it in fewer lines.

keepingTrack.question: What do I need to keep track of as I go?
keepingTrack.answer: The answer is a single number, and you don't know it until you've seen everyone. So ask yourself two things: what should that number be before you've looked at anybody at all, and what needs to happen to it when someone turns out **not** to be invited?

whichList.question: There are two lists here. Which one am I working through?
whichList.answer: Think about what the answer is counting. It's a number of people **in the queue**, so it's the queue you need to visit one person at a time. The guest list isn't something you walk through, it's the thing you check each person against.

realLifeBouncer.question: How would a real bouncer do this with a clipboard?
realLifeBouncer.answer: Picture them stood at the front of the queue with the clipboard in one hand, working their way towards the back. They only shout out the final number once they've reached the last person. What are they doing to each person on the way, and what are they doing about the ones whose names they can't find?
